curabilia. Sic Christian[?] miles habet quasi pectus
suum, in quo est cor, sedes spiritualis illius ac cæ-

page.notes: Doubtful: "Christian[?]" (the mark after "Christian" is unclear, possibly a superscript or abbreviation); "ilto[?]" in "Thorace ilto" (the first letter is uncertain). The first letter of "suam" at the start of the line after "galeam" is clipped at the left edge, so it reads "suam" by context. The word "cor" at the end of the page is complete.
